reference_likeness.reason: Frank has not approved reference likeness. Technical tests cannot supply creative approval.

silhouette.reason: Two arms/two legs/one tail retained. Reference muscular feline neck/shoulder/body relationship, costume layering and cape silhouette remain insufficient.

face.reason: Actual orbital boundary loops are repaired, muzzle/cheeks/ears reshaped and atlas corrected. Rounded skull, protruding mouth/lip planes and long neck remain visibly simplified; expression/speech range incomplete.

hands_digits.reason: Actual rig has FOUR digit chains per paw; ten proposed ventral pads are bound to existing bones. Paw volume, pad integration, grasp anatomy and wrist contour remain unconvincing and require anatomy review.

prop_contact.reason: CaptureReach clip and real paw motion are exercised, but actual leopard-to-target capture contact has not been qualified. Campaign species mapping remains unapproved; no weapon/prop invented.

clothing_deformation.reason: Cape root chest weights and seven thickened/bevelled armour parts improve attachment. Neck/armour joins, cape/belt clearance and tight-turn/reach secondary deformation remain unresolved.

limb_deformation.reason: Original 64 rest bones and nine actions retained. Paw/wrist/ankle/tail-root natural volume and extreme poses still need a corrective anatomy/weights pass despite valid transforms.

material_quality.reason: Original broken-rosette atlas, scale-controlled UVs, muzzle/throat paint and armour/cape roughness revised. Seams, broad flat fur treatment and rigid costume finish remain below the reference.

cinematic_readability.reason: Viewport framing retains geometry, but HUD still overlaps the head/ears in native inspection captures; manual exposure/soft sources do not cure this. Close facial/neck/mouth forms remain unsuitable for final cinematic acceptance.

gameplay_readability.reason: Actual packaged movement and character-specific motion execute; intentional pose/expression/costume readability remains a human review gate.

source_scene_verified.reason: Exact editable scene verified; 64 unchanged rest bones, 9 retained actions, normalized finite weights and source/native posed probes pass. Actual solid/topology/skeleton/weight views exist.

package_verified.reason: Exact fresh candidate rendered scenario, checked actual asset binding, assertions and normal process exit.

rig.units: Native Unreal centimetres; rotations xyzw quaternion; local parent frame
